notes.title: Upcoming Game Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

Just a quick update to outline what's coming up next for Cube Defender. 

I'm continuing to tweak the game, improving how it plays and overall making it feel fairer and more balanced. The next content update (which is planned for July) will contain updates to the following:

[list]
[*] [b]Sound Overhaul[/b]: Currently the game sounds are all in 2D, meaning you hear turrets firing from across the map. In the next update most non UI sound will be switched to 3D sounds so you only hear them when applicable.
[*] [b]Additional Level Combinations[/b]: Additional level combinations to bring in new variety to the gameplay. The end goal is to make these levels scale even better so that at the start of the game you'll face levels with 1 wave spawner, but in later levels you'll face several
[*] [b]New Achievements / Stats[/b]: Additional achievements are in the works. These will most likely be non standard ones, e.g upgrading X items in X seconds (edge cases) 
[*] [b]Linux Support[/b]: I've been testing out the Linux port and it seems to run stably so with the next release I'll officially be supporting Linux.
[*] [b]Game Saves[/b]: Right now there's no real game state to store your high scores and other user data (achievements are on Steam's side and local high scores haven't been a focus). With the next update I'm looking to sync data through steam so that if you uninstall the game your scores (and later on more complex data) will persist.
[/list]

I also have a few thoughts on doing the following:

[list]
[*] Adding in additional changes to Endless Mode (providing a way for the enemies to fight back against the turrets so you have to keep repairing)
[*] Additional new background music tracks. This will be dependent on what music I can create or find to suit the game
[*] Additional UI tweaks and further adjustments
[/list]

Thanks for the support guys. I'm keen to keep updating this game until it reaches a really solid foundation I can be proud of.

For any feedback please feel free to leave a comment or PM here on here.

Cheers

notes.title: New Enemies Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just a quick update to let you know what I've been working on the past few weeks and what's coming next.

[h1]New Upcoming Enemies[/h1]

I've been working hard on introducing additional enemies into Cube Defender. 

Along with the standard cubes you've seen so far, you'll also have to content with a few new enemies and their unique mechanics

[list]
[*] [b]Parent Cube[/b] - When this cube is defeated it spaws additional cube enemies from where it died. These cubes will keep you on your feet as you need to not only keep them from the end of the path, but also ensure you can deal with their spawned cubes when it dies.

[*][b]Attraction Cube[/b] - This slow moving and low damage dealing cube might seem weak, but it's power is that is causes turrets it passes by to drop it's current target and focus attention only on it. This will mean you'll need to place turrets away from the main path to ensure it can't be ensnared by this new enemy. 

This one requires a significant amount of time to balance to ensure it's common enough to cause annoyance, but not so common as to be overwhelming.

[*][b]Additional Cubes[/b] - I'm still working on a range of *other* cubes that may make it in this next release, or may be left for a subsequent update. I'd like to add a whole heap of cubes each update, but these all need to be balanced so each one feels distinctive. 

[/list]

[h1]Additional Tweaks / Improvements[/h1]

There have been continual tweaks to the game overall, including some balance tweaks, adjustments to the higher difficulties and a few bug fixes to resolve a few edge cases. 

Overall I'll continue to balance the game as new enemies, turrets and level types are introduced to ensure the game feels fair :)

[h1]When's It Coming?[/h1]

I'm aiming for a mid April release date for these changes so I can properly balance and hunt down any issues. 

I'm keen to hear anyone's feedback about enemies overall, along with any suggestions about additional enemy types / mechanics.

Cheers guys :)

notes.title: Version 1.3 (Steam Achivements & Leaderboard support)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

I've been busy working on additional features for Cube Defender and this content update brings in support for both [b]Steam Achivements[/b] and [b]Steam Leaderboards[/b]

[h1]Achivements[/h1]

As [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1000130/announcements/detail/1751240246277951851]previously mentioned in the last post[/url], I've been working on adding in a range of achivments you can unlock while you play. There are currently [b][u][b]21 Achivements to unlock[/b][/u][/b]. Some of these achivements are straight forward, while other ones will take several playthroughs.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1000130/achievements/]Click here to see the current list of achivements[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/0cef412a988ceac9ea5ffe24d9ba7293fa547df0.jpg[/img]

Some of these achivements are [b]stats based [/b](e.g number of cubes destroyed overall), while [b]some of them are situational [/b](e.g unlocking all turrets in a single playthrough). Have a look out for these achivments next time you play :)
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/3d6bbb7cd5db2e6907b81cc7fc2477b02f153e14.jpg[/img]


[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]

Leaderboard support has also been added. These leardboard will keep track of metrics you generate through your Cube Defender playrthough including:

[list]
[*] Total Player Score
[*] Number Of Cubes Destroyed
[*] Number of Levels Completed
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/ff2a17bb89f596fa0e1ac88f7cb4c68c65fd5755.jpg[/img]

The leaderboards will help you rank your progress again other Cube Defender players. For now there are three primary leaderboards, but more may be added in future updates so you can more easily see your progress.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1000130/leaderboards/3245037]Click here to see the current leaderboards[/url]

[h1]Additional Expansions[/h1]

There are additional plans for [b]more achivements[/b] down the track. These will most likely be a combination of progressive elements such as tracking how many cubes you've destroyed with the rocket launcher, along with stand alone achivements like destroying X number of cubes from bullet ricochets. 

An end goal will be to have around 50, with additional achivements being pushed out in the regular content updates for the game.

Feel free to reply to this post if you're interested in seeing certain types of achivements or if you're keen on additional leaderboards. 

Cheers

notes.title: Version 1.2 Updates (Quick Build Turret Interface)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

I've been hard at work the past week looking into additional adjustments to improve the Cube Defender experience.

Today I'm releasing the first version of the [b]Quick Build UI [/b].

Normally you'd place turrets by clicking on an open node to trigger the UI. This brings up the [b]Standard Build UI[/b] and it's here you can scroll through turrets, read what each of them does (their skills / effects) and choose which to build.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/599704d6de6bf565d19f74b9a27979f6084bb2bc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quick Build System[/h1]

That UI will still remain, but what you'll also have in addition is a new UI that's displayed at the bottom of the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/103983ebb063733aa1fec2ae705bdfdbfbdf4945.jpg[/img]

This UI works by giving you quick access to build a level 1 turret without having to open the build menu. Simple click on the turret you're trying to build and then click on on empty node, the turret is created and you're all good to go. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/e17ec8bf3267dd528ffee80d5030f7df44503482.gif[/img]

It's a great way to build turrets back to back without opening the menu. This should be especially helpful when you're in later levels when you already know what these turrets do and you just want to build several of them in quick succession.

[h1]Turret Unlocking[/h1]

Unlocking turrets can also be done through this new UI. Select the turret you want unlocked and if you have the currecy for it, it'll be unlocked and ready for use. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/a6056214c7ed7664034744d6088e2e561747032b.gif[/img]

Feel free to use either systems to build your turrets and let me know if you run into any issues.

Cheers

notes.title: Version 1.1.3 Updates (Added Mac Support)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

Just in-case anyone wanted to play Cube Defender on Mac, I've just pushed out an update that brings full Mac support. It's the same game as the windows version (with minor changes to the launcher)

The Mac version works on OSX 10.10 onward. Listed below are the minimum and recommended specs

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/8dfe54e84a8863f95f8ed44a8414c521847d8952.jpg[/img]

The game runs well on several Mac books and iMacs tested, including older 2014/2015 varieties. On Macs with dedicated video cards and newer CPUs you'll have noticeably faster and smoother gameplay. 

Give the Mac version a go if you have one handy and let me know if you see anything funny. 

Thanks guys!

notes.title: Cube Defender - Version 1.1 Updates
notes.notes:
[h1] Game changes and updates[/h1]

Thanks for everyones who's purchased Cube Defender and have taken the time to provide feedback, it's very much appreciated.

I've gone through the game and adjusted a few areas, most of which are bug fixes, adjustments to cater to certain resolutions and overall improving the level of polish. See below for a summary of these changes. 

[b]Changelog highlights [/b]

[list]
[*] Added horizontal scrolling to game help screens on smaller resolutions, preventing cut off text.

[*] Typos and spelling adjustments across turret and enemy UI elements

[*] Fixed mouse wheel scroll speed in help menu UI / build UI (was way too slow before, now it scrolls normally as expected)

[*] Fixed vertically cut off text in the turret build menu description (and reduced size)

[*] Adjusted turret explanation text (should be clearer what these turrets do now)

[*] Adjusted sizing for the enemy information UI (name was not showing because of text size )

[*] Adjusted 'devious cube' (green), so that it's skills dont have the 'basic enemy' skill. Added in the missing 'health regeneration' skill (as this cube heals slightly over time) [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/9a881dcc9946c3be396ed5c429a1776369a345c2.jpg[/img]

[*] Adjusted some basic start levels to make them easier (longer distance from spawn point to the end). This should make the first few levels easier. For example one of the levels has had it's path changed to make it several squares further away, giving players more chances to destroy cubes. [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34123103/7350bf456bbade3bb59c2e27fcb807149d95dbb5.jpg[/img]

[*] Adjusted several of the random methods in game to make the level generation process easier

[*] Additional performance fixes and debugging

[*] Fixed range indicator now showing up when hovering over 'Radial Turret'. This turret now shows its range when hovered over. 

[*] Fixed spawn issue with left to right starting level, it now spawns the correct 6 rounds of enemies before the level expands (was set on max spawn 2)
[/list]

Thanks everyone again for your feedback. I'm really looking forward to polishing up Cube Defender even more and introducing some new features in the next few weeks.
